articles.title: Trump Pauses Russia Sanctions, Drawing Criticism From Both Parties
articles.summary: President Trump paused new sanctions on Russia for 60 days, and leaders in Ukraine and in both US parties criticized the move.

articles.title: Taking Down Old Dams Is Helping Fish Return to Northeastern Rivers
articles.summary: Removing old dams in the Northeast is helping river herring swim back to rivers they once filled.
